version: 2026-06-12 IA1873 pp.001-029 plus source-checked working tranches through book page 267
title: James Clerk Maxwell: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I Source-Checked LaTeX Working Tranches
description:
Dedicated James Clerk Maxwell working-edition record for A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I. This version adds a compact first-edition reverification tranche for printed pp.001-029 / Internet Archive 1873 leaves 39-67, while retaining the earlier ledger-backed source-checked working tranches for book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and the main continuous run 111-267.

Status at a glance. This is not a complete Treatise edition and not a final critical edition. It should be cited as source-checked working tranches. The pp.001-029 package contains a page ledger, editable TeX, reader PDF, source witness PNG/JP2 images, render checks, promoted source-derived p.028 and p.029 figure crops, checksums, and a build diagnostic. The earlier package contains the source-check ledger, compact source-checked delta packets with page/range source witnesses and render checks, the current batch TeX/PDF substrate, Internet Archive master-image indexes and OCR/XML witnesses, audit notes, and SHA256 checksums.

Source-check ledgers and source witness images govern source-checked claims. OCR/XML material is used as a locator/witness layer, not as textual authority. The pp.001-029 reader build completes with one small overfull hbox of about 1.15305 pt; this is a layout-polish caveat rather than a missing-source claim.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Curated package created from the local Maxwell old-physics lane. Publish and read as source-checked working tranches, not as a complete Maxwell Treatise. Current verified ranges from the ledgers: pp.001-029 from the IA 1873 first-edition reverification lane, plus book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and 111-267 from the earlier working-tranche lane.
